notes.title: 23 Years of Mafia | Franchise Anniversary Sale 2025
notes.content:
[p]If you’re hungry for more gritty crime dramas after uncovering the origins of organized crime in [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941540/Mafia_The_Old_Country/"][u][i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i][/u][/url], this is the perfect chance to experience the Family's legacy with deep discounts on the games bundled in [i]Mafia: Trilogy[/i]. To celebrate the 23 Year Anniversary since 2002's original [i]Mafia[/i] first started this beloved series, [i]Mafia: Trilogy[/i] is on sale until September 8, 2025 at a price that may be tough to refuse.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9765926/39cee13e616eb2d17bdb228357815dee928b41fd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/mafiafranchisesale" style="button" buttoncolor="#b29160"]Mafia Franchise Sale[/url][/b][/h3][h3]
[url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48195/Mafia_Trilogy/"][u][i]Mafia: Trilogy[/i][/u][/url][url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48195/Mafia_Trilogy/"][u] Bundle[/u][/url][/h3][p]Live the life of a gangster across three distinct eras of organized crime in America. [i]Mafia: Trilogy[/i] collection includes [i]Mafia: Definitive Edition[/i], re-made from the ground up; [i]Mafia II: Definitive Edition[/i], remastered in HD; and [i]Mafia III: Definitive Edition[/i], which includes the main game, all story DLC, and Bonus Packs. This is your chance to pick up all three of these gritty crime dramas at an incredible price.[/p][p]
[/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1030840/Mafia_Definitive_Edition/"][u][i]Mafia: Definitive Edition[/i][/u][/url][/h3][p]1930s, Lost Heaven, IL. Rise through the ranks of the mafia during the Prohibition-era of organized crime in America. After an inadvertent brush with the mob, cabdriver Tommy Angelo is reluctantly thrust into the world of organized crime. Initially uneasy about falling in with the Salieri family, the rewards become too big to ignore.[/p][p]
[/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1030830/Mafia_II_Definitive_Edition/"][u][i]Mafia II: Definitive Edition[/i][/u][/url][/h3][p]1940s - 50s Empire Bay, NY. Remastered in HD, live the life of a gangster during the Golden-era of organized crime. War hero Vito Scaletta becomes entangled with the mob in hopes of paying his father’s debts. Alongside his buddy Joe, Vito works to prove himself, climbing the family ladder with crimes of larger reward, status, and consequence.[/p][p]
[/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/360430/Mafia_III_Definitive_Edition/"][u][i]Mafia III: Definitive Edition[/i][/u][/url][/h3][p]1968, New Bordeaux, LA. After years of combat in Vietnam, Lincoln Clay’s surrogate family, the black mob, is betrayed and murdered by the Italian Mafia. Lincoln builds a new family on the ashes of the old and blazes a path of military-grade revenge through the Mafioso responsible.[/p][p]

notes.title: Mafia: The Old Country is Out Now!
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="EAEYZDgHNv8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The time has finally come for you to join the Family. [i]Mafia: The Old Country [/i]launches today; please refer to our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1941540/view/523098355357712387"][u]Global Launch Times post[/u][/url] to see the exact time when it will be available for your region.[/p][p][/p][p]Uncover the origins of organized crime in this gritty mob story, set in the brutal underworld of 1900s Sicily. Fight to survive as Enzo Favara and prove your worth to the Family in this immersive third-person action-adventure set during a dangerous, unforgiving era.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Mafia: The Old Country [/i]players who have previously launched any of the [i]Mafia: Trilogy [/i]titles while logged into the same 2K Account can expect in-game rewards for their loyalty, which you can learn more about in [url="https://mafia.2k.com/the-old-country/news/mafia-franchise-loyalty-rewards/"][u]this article[/u][/url]*. Even if you're new to the series, all players who sign up for and log into the game with a new 2K Account can earn additional in-game rewards for [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i], which you can learn more about [url="https://mafia.2k.com/2k-account-rewards/"][u]on this page[/u][/url]*.[/p][p][/p][p]We also want to share a sincere message of gratitude from the team at Hangar 13 to the entire [i]Mafia [/i]community, whether you're just joining the Family today or you swore an oath of Omertá when the original game launched way back in 2002: [/p][p][/p][p]"It's hard to believe it's been nearly nine years since [i]Mafia III[/i]. So much has changed for us at Hangar 13, and as we reflect back, we're proud to say that one thing has stayed constant: our love for developing cinematic, narrative-driven games.[/p][p][/p][p]We believe there will always be a place for these types of experiences in our industry, as we saw first-hand with the reception to [i]Mafia: Definitive Edition[/i]. We were reminded just how much we love to create this style of game, and how much you—our fans—love to play them. [/p][p][/p][p]We're thrilled that [i]Mafia [/i]is back! And not only is it back, but [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] represents a bold return to the franchise's roots. It's a linear, cinematic experience driven by character and story. Most importantly, it's a mob movie you can step into and play out, just like every [i]Mafia [/i]title that came before—and it's best enjoyed spoiler-free, so we ask players to please honor the code of silence and preserve the narrative for others to play through at their own pace.[/p][p][/p][p]So, on behalf of all us at Hangar 13, thank you. Thank you for your support, your passion, and your dedication to this series that means so much to us. We hope you enjoy the game."[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157904/3f912084a9c0c3894e2da457b49ca26e2a9cf3cf.gif"][/img][/p][p]
To get fully up to speed before diving into this turn-of-the-century crime drama, read our recent [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1941540/view/523098355357712387"][u]"Preparing for Initiation" Q&A[/u][/url], as well as our earlier [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1941540/view/523094550774809122"][u]"The Road to Launch" Q&A[/u][/url], in which we answered the [i]Mafia [/i]community's most burning questions. Be sure to also check out our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1941540/view/523098355357712525"][u]PC Specs and Features[/u][/url] post where we break down the range of hardware required to run the game, and provide a list of PC-specific features and graphics settings.[/p][p]
[i]*Rewards require an internet connection and a 2K Account linked to the applicable Mafia title. One of each reward per 2K Account. Rewards will be automatically entitled in the applicable game. Void where prohibited. Terms apply.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941540/Mafia_The_Old_Country/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: PAX Panel | Mafia: The Old Country
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tmeirFVVzCA

Omertá has officially been broken. We kicked off PAX East by unveiling our action-packed new Gameplay Trailer, which revealed that [url=https://mafia.2k.com/the-old-country/news/pre-order/]Mafia: The Old Country launches August 8, 2025[/url]. The game is now available for pre-purchase on Steam.

Shortly after the trailer debuted, PAX East attendees and viewers at home got to witness a live behind-the-scenes look at the past, present, and future of [i]Mafia[/i] with the "Family Takes Sacrifice" developer panel, hosted by Kinda Funny's Greg Miller with Hangar 13 Studio President Nick Baynes, Game Director Alex Cox, and Cinematics Director Tomáš Hřebíček. In the VOD above, watch the in-depth discussion of the last 23 years of Mafia, glimpses at how Hangar 13 brought the underworld of 1900s Sicily to life for Mafia: The Old Country, a Q&A session, and more development insights.

https://youtu.be/lVhXaoX25AE

The deep dive into the series' history outlined how its thematic and design pillars have remained constant over the decades, and will continue to be explored further in [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i]. The retrospective also offered a rare window into the development of classic [i]Mafia[/i] titles, largely thanks to photos and anecdotes provided by Hřebíček, who has worked on every game in the series since the original [i]Mafia[/i] back in 2002. 

Thanks to everyone who attended the panel live in Boston or watched online; you're officially part of the family. To stay informed on all things [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i], make sure you opt into receiving our newsletters when you [url=https://mafia.2k.com/2k-account-rewards/]sign up for a 2K Account[/url]. Signing up and linking your 2K Account in [i]Mafia[/i]:[i] The Old Country[/i] also entitles you to the "Garzia Tumulto" Race Car reward, and linking your 2K Account in previous [i]Mafia[/i] titles entitles you to additional rewards in those games, as detailed in this [url=https://mafia.2k.com/the-old-country/news/mafia-franchise-loyalty-rewards/]Mafia Franchise Rewards[/url] article.

Stay on the lookout for more [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] details ahead of the game's August 8, 2025 release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941540/Mafia_The_Old_Country/

notes.title: Mafia: The Old Country is available for pre-purchase, launching August 8!
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UOIg2lFVsJE

[i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] is now available for pre-purchase on Steam. The game will offer two editions, [i]Standard Edition[/i] and [i]Deluxe Edition[/i], both of which release on August 8, 2025.

We're also excited to reveal that [i]Standard Edition[/i] and [i]Deluxe Edition[/i] will be priced at $49.99 and $59.99 respectively.* [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] is a compelling story that doesn't require a massive time commitment, and we believe these prices reflect the value of this highly-polished linear narrative experience.

Uncover the origins of organized crime in this gritty mob story set in the brutal underworld of 1900s Sicily. Fight to survive as Enzo Favara and prove your worth to the Cosa Nostra in this immersive third-person action-adventure set during a dangerous, unforgiving era.

Enzo will do anything for a better life. After a brutal childhood of forced labor, he's ready to risk everything to become a man of honor in the Torrisi crime family.

His oath to the Cosa Nostra, with all the power, temptation, and hardship it entails, is a burning reminder of this simple truth:

[b]Family Takes Sacrifice.[/b]

This thrilling narrative is brought to life by stunning visuals, cinematic storytelling, and the authentic realism that the critically acclaimed [i]Mafia[/i] series is known for. Enzo's story unfolds in a time when skill with a stiletto blade was a deadly asset, a [i]lupara[/i] sawed-off shotgun was a go-to firearm, murderous vendettas raged for decades, and mafiosi patrolled their protection rackets on foot, horseback, or behind the wheel of turn-of-the-century motorcars.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45157904/7efb125b6ee696625f3f107f7fa36b0c31542893.png[/img]

[h1]Pre-Purchase Bonus**[/h1]

Pre-purchase [i]Mafia: The Old Country Standard[/i] or [i]Deluxe Edition[/i] to receive The Soldato Pack, featuring weapon and character cosmetics, along with a helpful Charm that Enzo can equip for a passive in-game effect.**
[h2]The Soldato Pack contains:[/h2]
[list]
[*] "Soldato" Outfit
[*] "Scannaturi Speciale" Knife
[*] "Tesoro" Horse and Accessories
[*] "Lupara" Charm
[/list]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45157904/00595ccbd7ca859ffa448cd730d1da86e2c2ab25.png[/img]

[h1]Deluxe Edition[/h1]

[i]Mafia: The Old Country Deluxe Edition[/i] lets you descend into Sicily's criminal underworld in true Cosa Nostra style with a variety of bonus items for your collection.

[h2][i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] Deluxe Edition includes:[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3] Full base game[/h3]
[*] [h3]Padrino Pack***[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Lupara Speciale" Shotgun
[*] "Vendetti Speciale" Pistol
[*] "Immortale" Charm
[*] "Padrino" Outfit
[*] "Stiletto Speciale" Knife
[*] "Eckhart Speciale" Limousine
[*] "Cosimo" Horse and Accessories
[/list]
[*] [h3]Gatto Nero Pack***[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Bodeo Nero" Pistol
[*] "Velocità" Charm
[*] "Gatto Nero" Outfit
[*] "Carozella Nero" Race Car
[/list]
[*] [h3]Bonus Materials***[/h3]
[list]
[*] Digital Artbook
[*] Original Score
[/list]
[/list]
In addition to the full base game, purchasing [i]Mafia: The Old Country Deluxe Edition[/i] also grants you the Padrino Pack and the Gatto Nero Pack, plus digital Bonus Materials.***

The Padrino Pack lets you outfit Enzo with an ornate arsenal and accoutrements befitting a godfather with the special weapons, cosmetic items, and Charm that provides a passive in-game effect. The Gatto Nero Pack also lets you outfit Enzo like a member of an exclusive club with a special weapon, cosmetic items, and a Charm that provides a passive in-game effect. 

Additionally, the [i]Deluxe Edition[/i]'s included Bonus Materials, available in-game at launch, let you listen to the sweeping original score of [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] with the official soundtrack, and browse a digital artbook full of gorgeous concept art with behind-the-scenes insights from the developers. The original score for [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] was composed by BT, aka Brian Transeau, and was performed by the Czech National Symphony Orchestra. It also includes a number of traditional Sicilian folk songs, arranged by Peter McConnell and performed by a selection of Sicilian and American musicians.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45157904/c0b75f7366595e269c4c53c9b4aaa95749c8203d.png[/img]

[h1]2K Account rewards[/h1]

To expand your in-game collection even more, [url=https://mafia.2k.com/2k-account-rewards/]signing up for a free 2K Account[/url] earns you the "Garzia Tumulto" Race Car in-game reward, and playing past [i]Mafia[/i] titles while logged into a 2K Account will unlock additional rewards, as detailed in this [url=https://mafia.2k.com/the-old-country/news/mafia-franchise-loyalty-rewards/]Mafia Franchise Rewards[/url] article. Along with these items, signing up for a 2K Account also lets you sign up for newsletters, unlocking the "Lupara Tradituri" Shotgun and ensuring that you stay informed of all the latest [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] reveals.**** 

Also be sure to check out our [url=https://mafia.2k.com/the-old-country/faq/]updated FAQs page[/url], which addresses all of our most commonly asked questions about [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i].

And if you couldn't make it to our PAX East Developer Panel, catch up on everything you missed in our official recap [url=https://mafia.2k.com/the-old-country/news/pax-panel-family-takes-sacrifice/]here[/url]. Hosted by Kinda Funny's Greg Miller, longtime [i]Mafia[/i] developers from Hangar 13 gave an in-depth look back at the history of the franchise, as well as glimpses at how they brought 1900s Sicily to life in [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941540/Mafia_The_Old_Country/

**Pre-purchase offer available for Mafia: The Old Country Standard Edition and Deluxe Edition until August 8, 2025. Internet connection required to redeem bonus content. Items will be automatically entitled in-game at launch. Terms apply.

***Internet connection and base game required. Padrino Pack, Gatto Nero Pack, and Bonus Materials are included in the Deluxe Edition of Mafia: The Old Country.

****Each reward requires an internet connection and a 2K Account linked to the applicable Mafia title. One of each reward per 2K Account. Reward will be automatically entitled in the applicable game. Void where prohibited. Terms apply.[/i]

notes.title: The Team Behind Mafia: The Old Country Heads to PAX East!
notes.content:

Mafia fans understand the seriousness of breaking Omertá, so don't miss this chance to uncover the origins of organized crime with Mafia: The Old Country at PAX East!

On [b]May 8[/b] at [i]7pm BST[/i] and [i]2pm ET[/i], watch as Hangar 13 developers debut a new Gameplay Trailer and offer a rare behind-the-scenes look at the past, present, and future of this storied franchise, live from their panel discussion via the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/pax]PAX East Main Stream[/url] and the [url=https://www.youtube.com/@mafiagame]Mafia YouTube[/url] channel. We’ll also be sharing a dedicated Steam post where you can watch our PAX East broadcast, streaming live right here on Steam! That post will be made at a later time.

[list]

In-person attendees might also expect a little reward for their show of loyalty, and for those who can't make it to Boston, be sure to check our social channels for additional news coming out of the convention.

notes.title: Playing Mafia Definitive Edition in virtual reality feels like time travel
notes.content:
Luke Ross, the mastermind modder behind the impressive GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 R.E.A.L. VR mods released a new mod this week that brings virtual reality to the world of Mafia: Definitive Edition.

For those of you who don't know, Mafia: Definitive Edition is a faithful recreation of the 2002 original. It came with an expanded story, gameplay and a complete graphical overhaul that breathed a whole new lease of life into everyone's favourite Mafioso-based GTA-clone. Overall it's a really impressive remake and the new-look Lost Heaven is gorgeous. But with the added immersion offered by Luke's new mod, at times, it almost feel like you're actually there!

You can watch me drive, crash, run, jump, shoot and die my way through a couple of the game's early missions in this week's VR Corner below. Oh and I also spend a lot of my time just looking out of the windows of my cars going, "wooooooow, preeetttyyy!", because it really is.

Read more

notes.title: Mafia: Definitive Edition Out Now
notes.content:
Some 18 years after the critically acclaimed Mafia: The City of Lost Heaven first invited players to live the life of a gangster during the Prohibition Era, we're excited to announce that Mafia: Definitive Edition—a complete remake of the original game—is now available. The centerpiece of the [url=https://mafiagame.com/buy/]Mafia: Trilogy[/url] bundle, Mafia: Definitive Edition tells the story of Tommy Angelo, a [url=https://mafiagame.com/news/mafia-definitive-edition-lost-heaven-map]Lost Heaven[/url] cab driver who becomes enamored with a life in organized crime after an opportune brush with the Italian Mafia. It's the same enthralling story you might remember from the 2002 game, but fully remade from the ground-up and expanded, with beautiful presentation including stunning new visuals and an original orchestral score.

[previewyoutube=VHhnGQmqnJU;full][/previewyoutube]

The missions you take on after joining the ranks of a crime family at war are faithful to those that Tommy first tackled in 2002, but play quite differently courtesy of reworked vehicle handling, enhanced melee combat, a new cover system, the introduction of motorcycles, and a host of other improvements. Mafia: Definitive Edition is more accessible than the original game by design, but there are difficulty settings to suit newcomers and experienced mafiosos alike, including the most challenging [url=https://mafiagame.com/news/mafia-definitive-edition-classic-d]Classic Difficulty[/url] setting, which incorporates a number of old-school Mafia features. In another nod to Mafia: The City of Lost Heaven, Mafia: Definitive Edition also includes a [url=https://mafiagame.com/news/mafia-definitive-edition-free-ride-mode/]Free Ride[/url] mode that lets you explore the map and search for [url=https://mafiagame.com/news/mafia-definitive-edition-collectibles/]hidden collectibles[/url] and secrets at your own pace.

Mafia: Definitive Edition has been a labor of love for Hangar 13 and will continue to be even now that the game has launched. We've been paying close attention to your feedback, and we're planning to update the game with additional HUD customization options and some other cool stuff in the coming weeks. Check back for more details soon.

Whether this will be your first time experiencing Tommy Angelo's story or your fiftieth, we hope you enjoy your time with Mafia: Definitive Edition and we're excited to hear about your adventures in and around Lost Heaven.

notes.title: Mafia: Definitive Edition Official Gameplay Reveal
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=FEHwULac8MM;full][/previewyoutube]

Now that you've reacquainted yourself with Tommy Angelo and the city of Lost Heaven in the [url=https://mafiagame.com/news/mafia-definitive-edition-story-trailer-1/]"New Beginnings" narrative trailer[/url], we're proud to present the first gameplay trailer for [url=https://mafiagame.com/mafia]Mafia: Definitive Edition[/url]. In this new footage, narrated by Hangar 13 President and CCO Haden Blackman, you'll get more insight into how this remake has been built from the ground up by the team at Hangar 13, which includes developers who have worked on every game in the Mafia series.

Along with glimpses of Lost Heaven's bustling streets, period-authentic vehicles, and scenic skyline, the centerpiece of the gameplay trailer is an in-depth look at the mission "A Trip to the Country". We join Tommy on a job about midway through the story campaign, after he's established himself as a valued member of the Salieri Crime Family. Take in the foreboding atmosphere of a deal gone wrong in the pouring rain, then watch as Tommy and Paulie rush to the aid of their friend Sam during a chaotic barn shootout.

The Mafia: Definitive Edition Official Gameplay Reveal trailer is just a taste of what you can expect from this gripping 1930s crime saga. Mafia: Definitive Edition is currently available for pre-order and will launch later this year on September 25, 2020.
